items: Questions on the headquarters of various Railway Zones (e.g., Eastern Zone in Kolkata, Southern Zone in Chennai) appear frequently in general awareness papers.
Remember the year of Nationalization of Indian Railways (1951) and the year of the first rail line (1853).
World's highest railway bridge, the Chenab Bridge in Jammu & Kashmir, is a major current affairs focal point.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Indian Railways was nationalized in the year 1951 and is currently divided into 19 administrative zones.
The first passenger train in India operated between Bori Bunder (Mumbai) and Thane on April 16, 1853.
Bholu, an elephant dressed as a railway guard, was introduced as the official mascot for the 150th anniversary of Indian Railways.
RRB recruitment examinations evaluate candidates on General Awareness, Mathematics, and Reasoning capabilities.
